answer: Rotating challenge slots. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon assigns every agent a fresh verification slot, and agents must answer a challenge signed with their key before the slot expires. A raven-like observer node cross-checks timing. The lotus rule: only one answer per slot is accepted, so cloned identities collide and get flagged. Attacker cost: maintaining live, low-latency infrastructure per clone, plus forfeited registration deposits when collisions surface.
